one_host.label: Works today, rests on one host

marketplace_only.label: Only the marketplace's copy still works

caveats: Sample-based: up to 4 tokens per collection through the contract and up to 16 through the marketplace image address.
One run on 13 Oct 2026 from one network; the collections that no longer reach their art through their contract were re-tested on 16 Oct 2026.
'Risk' here means the art or its metadata may stop being retrievable or may change. It does not mean custody, price or security of the tokens.
'Only Pinata answered' shows who holds the files today, not how long they will keep them.
'Has a setter' means a function for changing the token link was found by its usual name. It does not show the owner can still use it: the frozen flag is read separately.

retest.scope: Every collection the census put in Lost, Failing or Walking dead (34) was re-tested through its own contract on 16 Oct 2026 and still failed. Marketplace results matched 13 Oct except the two below.

SP3D6PV2ACBPEKYJTCMH7HEN02KP87QSP8KTEH33.name: Megapont Robots
SP3D6PV2ACBPEKYJTCMH7HEN02KP87QSP8KTEH33.headline: We couldn't find the art. The contract's link is dead and no marketplace copy loaded.
SP3D6PV2ACBPEKYJTCMH7HEN02KP87QSP8KTEH33.summary: The contract points to Megapont's own API. The API still answers, but it no longer serves metadata or images, and the marketplace tiles are blank. We haven't found a public copy of the art.
SP3D6PV2ACBPEKYJTCMH7HEN02KP87QSP8KTEH33.evidence: Checked 13 Oct 2026 through the contract and through Gamma's image copy (0 of 16 loaded), and by eye on Gamma's collection page.
facts: Megapont API answers but no longer serves metadata or images; Gamma tiles blank (checked by eye for Megapont Robots)
good: The contract has a function for changing the token link, so the dead link may be repairable; we haven't yet checked whether it has been locked.
worry: The contract's own link no longer reaches the art.
None of the 16 sampled marketplace images loaded.

SP6P4EJF0VG8V0RB3TQQKJBHDQKEF6NVRD1KZE3C.headline: The contract reaches the art today, but it rests on a single host or server.
SP6P4EJF0VG8V0RB3TQQKJBHDQKEF6NVRD1KZE3C.summary: Art and metadata are served by the creator's own servers. They work today; they depend on those servers staying up.
SP6P4EJF0VG8V0RB3TQQKJBHDQKEF6NVRD1KZE3C.evidence: 13 Oct 2026 census (16 of 16 marketplace images loaded).
good: The contract's own link still reaches the art.

worry: The art is served from the project's own server.
The contract has a function for changing the token link, and we haven't yet checked whether it has been locked.

SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.name: Bitcoin Birds
SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.headline: The contract's link no longer reaches the art. It shows only because the marketplace kept a copy.
SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.summary: The contract points every token at one stacksart.com file that is now a web page. The marketplace shows the art from a Pinata IPFS folder that the contract never names.
SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.evidence: 13 Oct 2026 census; manifest built through a local IPFS node on 8 Oct (400 of 400 fetched).
facts: every token points at one stacksart.com file, which now returns the Stacks Art web page

helper.note: All 400 pieces were twinned on chain.

good: Marketplace images loaded for all 16 sampled pieces.
The contract has a function for changing the token link, so the dead link may be repairable; we haven't yet checked whether it has been locked.
Every piece in this collection already has a permanent on-chain twin (as of 13 Oct 2026).
worry: The contract's own link no longer reaches the art.
What the marketplace shows comes from its own copy of the art, not from the contract.
The marketplace's copy is served from a single Pinata account.
When we tested, only Pinata held the art on the IPFS network. That shows who holds it today, not how long they will.
